authors: C. Fabre, S. Haroche, P. Goy
title: Addendum to "Millimeter spectroscopy in sodium Rydberg states"
method: atomic-beam millimeter-wave spectroscopy (50-315 GHz, carcinotrons, frequency counted), selective field ionization
caveats: Intervals only; nS energies needed to place nP levels.

Dyubko et al. (1995) report the same nS-nP transitions (n=23-25, 32) lower by 0.5-3 MHz and attribute the difference to stray-field Stark shifts in this experiment (residual field ~40 mV/cm quoted here).
Fine-structure rows are differences of Table I/II rows.
